facts.meaning: Battle::Peer.pbStorePokemon appends directly to nonfull party and returns-1 before HEAL_STORED_POKEMON. For fullparty and flagtrue it saves ready_to_evolve, heals, then restores that flag before storage.pbStoreCaught. Flagfalse skips this wrapper heal. Negative storage result displays failure and returns old current box; it is not automatic rollback of healing.
facts.control: CurrentMECH8 derives flagfalse. Party insertion and box storage are distinct paths; source does not prove storage container never heals independently.
facts.failure_prefix: Healing may clear ready_to_evolve before a heal failure prevents restoration; later storage failure retains healed Pokemon. Oldbox read precedes store; diagnostic failure can prevent return after earlier state. No ensure.
facts.open: Complete storage container/caller capture/party-full/native save semantics remain separate; this does not add whole Battle::Peer FULL.

facts.meaning: pbPurify exits unless shadowPokemon? and gauge==0. It increments shadow_pokemon_purified before clearing shadow/hyper flags, ribbon, display, move restoration/firstmoves, savedEV recovery and savedEXP processing. savedEV is cleared only after add_evs returns. savedEXP is cleared before growth-level calculation/display/changeLevel/exp writes. Nickname confirmation occurs after all purification state effects.
facts.control: This method itself does not call purifiable? or excludeLugia; valid caller eligibility is separate. Nickname decline leaves purification complete and changes no name. SavedEXP zero is truthy, so still traverses its branch.
facts.failure_prefix: Count/flags/ribbon can remain on later display/move/EV/EXP failure. savedEXP can be nil before level processing fails; nickname cancel never rolls back count or restored state. No transaction/save.
facts.open: Complete ribbon/EV/EXP/level/evolution/scene callbacks and caller eligibility are independently scoped; counter name is reached purification entry, not all downstream-success guarantee.

facts.meaning: pbOrganizedBattleEx DebugCtrl early messages/lastrecordnil/MEStop returnstrue before ordinary stats. Ordinary path heals, adjusts levels, caches items, runs noninternal facility battle, unadjusts/heals/unmega/unprimal/restores both parties, resets lastrecord then dumps only decisions1/2/5. Only afterwards decision1 increments trainer_won;2/3/5 increments trainer_lost; returns decision==1. Thus facilitydraw/flee countlost, unlike ordinary set_outcome classification.
facts.control: Decision3 has no dumpedrecord but countslost. Debugskip returnswinboolean without either count. No inference that every noninternal Battle uses this exact wrapper.
facts.failure_prefix: Level/party/item/record restore happens sequentially without ensure. Dump failure can occur after restoration and lastrecordclear but before stats. Stats increment is late, not proof earlier cleanup atomicity.
facts.open: Complete rule adjustment/record dump/battle audio/native scene and persisted record consumers remain separate; correct audio channel facts are not newly inferred here.

facts.meaning: TrainerBattle.start only caches waiting_trainer when no existingwaiting, map interpreter running, double battle possible, exactlyone other unswitched triggered trainer event, generated trainer count1 and party.length<=MAX_PARTY_SIZE(default6). Cache stores trainer plus current eventID and returnsfalse before battle. Nextcall with waiting appends trainer, runs start_core, sets waiting event selfswitchA only outcome1, then clears waiting. Returns outcome==1.
facts.control: MAX_PARTY_SIZE here is a pending simultaneous-trainer cache eligibility threshold, not a general alltrainer party truncation. Cached-returnfalse is defer outcome, not necessarily lost battle.
facts.failure_prefix: Generation/load callbacks may occur before cache; start_core failure retains waiting. Outcome1 selfswitch failure prevents waiting clear. Earlier roster/scene effects do not rollback.
facts.open: Complete generate_foes/event triggering/double eligibility/start_core/selfswitch receiver remain independently scoped; no whole TrainerBattle acceptance.

facts.meaning: End-battle handler requests EvolutionCheck when CHECK_EVOLUTION_AFTER_ALL_BATTLES(defaultMECH8 true) OR decision not2/5. Only after it returns clears three prebattle arrays, then win/capture Pickup/Honey or loss/draw withoutcanLose unpause/startover. EvolutionCheck iterates current party indices, skipsnil/eggs, skipsfainted only when CHECK_EVOLUTION_FOR_FAINTED_POKEMON false(defaulttrue). It tries level-up evolution only when corresponding savedlevel exists and less than currentlevel, then afterbattle method if none, then scene start/evolve/end.
facts.control: At defaults losses/draws and fainted nonEgg members can be checked. FlippingallBattles false still checks every decisionexcept2/5, not justwin. Declining/cancelling EvolutionScene is its own return; outer loop has no automatic abort-on-cancel flag.
facts.failure_prefix: Evolution or scene failure can leave individual changes and prebattle arrays uncleared, preventing later pickup/blackout. Earlier party entries can evolve before later failure. Scene end is normal sequence without ensure.
facts.open: Complete evolution callbacks/scene cancellation, Pickup/Honey, current party ownership and native save remain independently named; existing CRE lifecycle finite facts are retained rather than duplicated full-domain credit.

facts.meaning: Wild battle intro after intro/data-box/intro2 animation loops checks showAnims, existing battler and shiny?; chooses SuperShiny only when Settings.SUPER_SHINY and battler.super_shiny?, otherwiseShiny. SendOut likewise only after all fade/sendout loops and disposal, for each shiny sentout when showAnims. Trainer battle intro returns after lineups before wild shiny branch. Pokemon shiny?/super_shiny? lazily cache PIDxorOwner thresholds; super_shiny= true also sets shinytrue, false does not clear shiny.
facts.control: SUPER_SHINY changes requested animation name, not probability/PID or guarantee that every shiny is super. Flagfalse uses normalShiny for super-shiny Pokemon. Sendout visual Pokemon may be Illusion but sparkle predicate is actual battler wrapper; that wrapper remains separately scoped.
facts.failure_prefix: Animations/sprite changes/refresh/loops/disposal precede shiny request; failures skip later requests and have no ensure cleanup. Lazy getters can cache values before animation failure. No native pixels/audio/assets loaded by review.
facts.open: Complete Battler shiny delegation/Animation classes/CommonAnimation/native resources and all scene loops remain OPEN beyond exact selected consumer meaning.

common_premise: Fixed R and valid selected ordinary callers. These six new meanings bind9 remaining Settings/Stats lexical consumers. Existing Settings/Stats producer and outer SaveData facts are referenced, not re-reviewed or granted whole-domain acceptance. Only necessary complete selected source units are newly read, no additional sourceFULL or native target execution.
persistence: Existing registered Stats/Pokemon/Global roots only; runtime scene/record/temp are not newly promoted save roots. All native roundtrip/inner compatibility remains separate.
remaining: Original714 consumer denominator is finite input, with additional discovered locations separately retained. Exact unreceived successors stay OPEN; no new finding/context/vote.
